messages.text: My miner broke within a week and I haven't heard anything from you since last Friday

Sorry about that, and sorry you've been left waiting since Friday. Let me pick it up now.

Can you give me your order number and the name it ships to? With that I'll pull it up, see where things stand, and get our tech, Hal, on the fault itself. If you can add a line on what the unit is doing (no power, no hashrate, error on screen), that speeds it up.
And it sounds from the pump, not the fan

Thanks Marcus, that settles it, and I'm back on the order side.

Hal has it down as a failed pump, which is a genuine fault, not something you can fix at your end. Keep it unplugged until we sort it.

Your BS-2 arrived October 2 and failed within days, and then you waited from Friday with no word. I'm sorry for both. The return is with the team for approval now, and they'll confirm it to you by email shortly, at (email hidden) Nothing more needed from you in the meantime.
